name: remote-sandbox-terminal
description: opencode running somewhere else, in your terminal, over Upstash Realtime.

scripts.build: bun build src/host.ts --target=node --format=esm --external @lydell/node-pty --outfile dist/host.mjs && bun build src/client.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile dist/oc.mjs
scripts.test:box: bun run build && E2E_REMOTE=1 node test/e2e.mjs
